question: Which of the following devices is used to convert alternating current into direct current?
solution:
The correct answer is **Rectifier**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **rectifier** is an electrical device that converts alternating current (AC) to direct current (DC).
 
• It works by allowing current to flow only in one direction.
 
• Rectifiers are used in power supplies for electronic devices.
